fields.System.Title: RPL-201 — Detect below-minimum on stock movement
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a picker, I want the system to notice when a pick face drops low, so that it is
refilled before I arrive to find it empty.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given inventory.stock_moved reduces a pick location below its rule minimum, then
  • evaluation is triggered for that location.
  • - Given a location above its minimum, then nothing happens.
  • - Given a scheduled run, then every rule is also evaluated periodically as a safety net.
  • - Given the trigger, then it uses available quantity, not on-hand — stock reserved for
  • an order does not count as stocked.
  • - Given a blocked pick location, then no evaluation occurs.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment, inventory |
| Tables | replen_rule, stock_balance |
| Risks | Using on-hand instead of available under-triggers replenishment |
| Tests | unit · integration |
